title: Tagine Stuffed Courgette
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from North Africa, made with roasted courgette and a blend of spices.
instructions: Cut the courgette in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds.
In a bowl, mix together the tagine spice blend, olive oil, onion, garlic, and chopped tomatoes.
Stuff each courgette half with the spice mixture, dividing it evenly.
Place the stuffed courgette on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the courgette is tender.
While the courgette is roasting, cook the quinoa according to package instructions.
Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork and stir in chopped cilantro, if using.
Serve the roasted courgette with the quinoa mixture on the side.
